ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: I chose Dunlin because the query asks for a thorough, analytical explanation of a complex socioeconomic topic, and the user explicitly demanded depth over surface-level content. Dunlin has meaningfully higher capability scores (MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 74.8, GPQA 64.1 vs 54.3, Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 81.4) plus a several-point edge on internal evals like Summarization and Policy/Moderation — all of which point to a more substantive, well-reasoned response. Since the content is neutral and not harm-adjacent, the task-preference differences between the two models weren't a deciding factor; the choice came down to raw capability.
